Definition: a falling off, i.e. chaff; also something pendulous, i.e. a flap
BiblicalUsage: mappâl carries two pictures, the chaff that falls off in winnowing and the flakes that hang loose. In Amos 8:6 the greedy sell the refuse of the wheat to the poor, and in Job 41:23 the flakes of Leviathan's flesh are joined together and cannot be moved. The word is what falls away and what hangs on.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mappâl shows me the difference between refuse and strength, and I hold that God separates the chaff from the wheat in His own time.
